speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Occupational Irritant-Induced Bronchitis (likely due to silica or cement dust exposure). Given your inconsistent use of respiratory protection and the clear correlation between dust exposure and symptom worsening, I recommend a high-resolution CT scan of the chest to rule out early pneumoconiosis or silicosis, which can present with chronic cough and bronchial thickening.
